summary: Completed testing of coaching panel features for format-specific coaching data. All 6 requested features tested and PASSED. 11v11 coaching shows Team Level/Defensive Line/Attack categories with Guardiola/Sacchi/Simeone/Ancelotti/Tuchel/Bielsa coaches. 5v5 futsal coaching shows Rotation & Shape/Defending/Attack with Falcao/Ricardinho/Marcos/Higuita/Jorge Braz coaches. Quote position correctly at BOTTOM (after Apply button). Arrows appear on pitch after applying tactics.

test_4_5v5_futsal_coaching_categories.description: 5v5 futsal coaching panel shows 3 categories: Rotation & Shape (2 tactics), Defending (2 tactics), Attack (2 tactics)

test_6_apply_tactic_arrows.description: After clicking APPLY ON PITCH, arrows appear on the pitch and 'ACTIVE TACTICS' section appears. Match log shows 'Coach:' event.
